title: The web client moves out of the server's package; board --ui <folder>|none
summary: Specified and settled (03-change-spec.md, 02-answers.md's five answers): the web UI moves to chantier/clients/web/ in the one wheel; board --ui <folder>|none, a folder needs an index.html, --ui not applied on a running board; the server names nothing of it.
